 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The New York Jets are on the road in Kansas City, Missouri today. They will be taking on the Kansas City Chiefs. The game is scheduled to start shortly after 1:00 pm EST.
 The game will be played in beautiful, warm sunny weather. Clear skies will prevail for the entirety of the game. Winds will be light and variable at around 0 to 5 mph with a few higher gusts out of the west northwest to start the game, shifting to the northwest as the game progresses. Temperatures will be in the low 60s to start the game, rising to the mid 60s as the game progresses. Relative humidity will be moderate, starting in the high 50s and dropping to the mid 50s by game's end. There will be a near zero chance of precipitation throughout the game.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In short, this will be a glorious November day for football. Conditions will be near ideal for the players and fans alike. For the players the only effect the weather might have on the game could be the bright sun in a clear sky. It's possible players could lose sight of the ball while staring into the sun on pass plays or kick returns. For the fans, a light jacket or sweatshirt might be appropriate. Other than that, what a great day for football! Enjoy the game everyone.
